scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Unit 3 Week 3 (Week of November 30), I DO Skill / Strategy Named] Explanatory writers use ADVERBS to explain HOW, WHEN, or WHERE something happens. 'The fennec fox hunts silently at night' is more informative than 'the fennec fox hunts.'
[Unit 3 Week 3 (Week of November 30), Anchor Chart / Visual Created] Chart 5: 'Comparing Two Texts — Same Topic, Different Details' — T-chart with Fennec Foxes vs. Gila Monster's Burrow: Similar (both burrow, both desert, both nocturnal) / Different (diet, appearance, specific adaptations).
